cues.text: Which value is two times the diastolic, plus the systolic, all divided by 3?
because two thirds of the cardiac cycle is spent in diastole.
Systolic pressure is counted once, and the total is divided by 3.
This gives the mean arterial pressure, or MAP.
A MAP of 60 is needed to perfuse the coronary arteries, brain and kidneys; the reference range is 70 to 100 mmHg.
So remember: MAP equals two diastolic plus one systolic, over 3.
